title: Radar sites built 1946, plus Mori Arti and Continental bases

tellings.quote: When Scott dug into it, he found out the site was originally built in 1946 before being moved in 1950. He also [music] found two other bases close by, Mori Arti and Continental, although those weren't active until around 1950 or 51.

plain: A military site in New Mexico was first built in 1946 and then moved in 1950, according to what a man named Scott Ramsey found when he looked into it, and two other bases nearby, called Mori Arti and Continental, only became active around 1950 or 1951. Michels passes on Ramsey's findings in an episode about a claimed crash that left sixteen alien bodies, where the dates matter because they would show which installations were already there at the time.
